title: Contradiction to Consensus: Dual-Perspective, Multi-Source Retrieval-Based Claim Verification with Source-Level Disagreement using LLM

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot claim verification performance (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1) when retrieving evidence using only the original claim versus using a dual-perspective approach that retrieves evidence for both the original and explicitly negated claims to capture contradicting viewpoints.
